subject: Procurement pathways & stakeholder sync — next steps and steering committee
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@retailco.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@retailco.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement pathways & stakeholder sync — next steps and steering committee

Hi Sarah / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the time today. Short recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same action items.

Call summary (30 min)
- Primary drivers: reduce inference cost per transaction, improve P99 latency for checkout personalization, and guarantee auditability for data flows.
- Initial architecture preferences: hosted API for PoC, private deployment considered for production due to data retention requirements.

Stakeholder map (as discussed)
- Economic buyer: Rajiv Menon, CTO (ultimate sign-off on TCO & procurement).
- Security/InfoSec PO C: Alex Cho (security evaluation + questionnaire).
- Legal: Linda Park (contract redlines / data processing addendum).
- Procurement: procurement@retailco.com (PO cadence / vendor onboarding).

Decision criteria we heard
1) Latency SLOs (P99 targets for peak window).
2) Unit cost per 1k tokens (or per inference).
3) Security posture: SOC 2 + pen test + data residency controls.
4) Operational playbook: rollback, canary, and runbook for incidents.

Immediate asks / next steps
- Can you confirm the economic buyer and the primary procurement contact?
- Please share the security questionnaire contact (we'll prep SOC 2 / DSR docs + architecture diagram).
- Proposed steering committee: 45 minutes with Rajiv + Security + Procurement + Engineering. Two candidate slots: 2027-09-20 10:00–10:45 PT or 2027-09-22 13:00–13:45 PT. Which works best?

Attachments: redwood-discovery-notes.pdf (summary + quick ROI calc).

I'll follow up with an internal prep note and a proposed agenda once we lock the date.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0112

Monica — really clear notes, thanks. Quick confirmations from our side: 

- Economic buyer: confirmed (Rajiv Menon). He'll attend the steering committee.
- Procurement intake and PO path: procurement@retailco.com (please complete the intake spreadsheet attached). They typically take 4–6 weeks for standard SaaS vendor onboarding, longer for on-prem options.
- Security POC: Alex Cho (cc'd) will own the questionnaire and initial evidence collection. The items we will request up front: SOC 2 Type II report, most recent external penetration test summary, and a data flow diagram for how tokens/data move through the service.

Availability: Rajiv is available for the 2027-09-20 10:00 PT slot; procurement would prefer 2027-09-22 but can make the 20th if needed. Can you lock 20th for the core steering committee and follow with a procurement-only intake the week after?

Attached: procurement-intake.xlsx (filled basic vendor fields).

Thanks — Alex, Linda: any immediate asks from security/legal before the steering session?

—Sarah
